aiSummary.temperatureTooltip: This parameter controls the randomness of the model's predictions. A lower temperature results in more conservative responses, while a higher temperature yields more creative and diverse responses.
aiSummary.topPTooltip: Also known as "nucleus sampling", this parameter sets a threshold for selecting a smaller set of the most likely words to sample from, cutting off the less probable ones.
aiSummary.presencePenaltyTooltip: This discourages the model from repeating the same information by penalizing words that have already appeared in the conversation.
aiSummary.frequencyPenaltyTooltip: Similar to the presence penalty, this reduces the model’s tendency to repeat the same words frequently.

searchSettings.similarityTooltip: RAGFlow employs either a combination of weighted keyword similarity and weighted vector cosine similarity, or a combination of weighted keyword similarity and weighted reranking score during retrieval. This parameter sets the threshold for similarities between the user query and chunks. Any chunk with a similarity score below this threshold will be excluded from the results. By default, the threshold is set to 0.2. This means that only chunks with hybrid similarity score of 20 or higher will be retrieved.
searchSettings.vectorWeightTooltip: This sets the weight of keyword similarity in the combined similarity score, either used with vector cosine similarity or with reranking score. The total of the two weights must equal 1.0.
